high_level_description: stc brand style, a futuristic scene of a hand interacting with a glowing tablet displaying holographic financial data.

compositional_deconstruction.background: A dark surface illuminated by dramatic red and blue neon lighting, with a secondary monitor showing financial charts in the background and a small potted plant partially in frame.

elements.desc: A glowing blue tablet computer displaying a circular radial chart, with a hand reaching down to interact with it.
Multiple floating holographic data visualizations above the tablet, including bar graphs, line charts, and stock market candlestick patterns in blue and white.
A secondary computer monitor in the background displaying financial charts and blue and white candlestick patterns.
